integrity: The complete twenty-vertex odd-independent-set census, exact cover recurrence, nonexistence of a four-colour partition, five-colour certificate, and two square-colouring partitions are validated by two included stand-alone exhaustive enumerators. The source results on Petersen colourings and general bounds are credited, not asserted as new.
limitations: Exact results are for the single twenty-vertex graph GP(10,2); no classification for other generalized Petersen graphs is asserted. All 212 optimal colour partitions are counted on fixed labelled vertices, with colour names forgotten. Independent external mathematical validation and exhaustive historical-priority clearance remain outstanding.
title: Strong odd colourings of the dodecahedral graph: a 212-partition census and a square-colouring gap
